ffa617857253dbecc3a5371f478e33e4b1625baa.summary: Trend Micro TrendLabs blog on the Sandworm attacks that exploited CVE-2014-4114, a command injection flaw in the Microsoft OLE infrastructure that was used through PowerPoint files. It sets out a 2014 timeline: the iSIGHT disclosure on October 14, the MS14-060 fix that day, a bypass disclosed on October 21, and an email campaign from August 13. It describes how the file-type trick evades Mark of the Web warnings and notes the related CVE-2014-6352. The report says the technique has been around since at least October 2013.
